hoa.msg.account_training_can_now_go.enUS: Account Training is now unlocked up to rank {1}.
hoa.msg.account_training_can_now_go.zhCN: 账号训练现在最高可提升至{1}级。

hoa.msg.affix_bolstering_text.enUS: When it dies, nearby enemies gain {1} more health and damage.
hoa.msg.affix_bolstering_text.zhCN: 它死亡时，附近敌人的生命值和伤害提高{1}。

hoa.msg.affix_bulwark_text.enUS: Shields itself for {1} of its health. A new shield forms {2} after the old one breaks or fades.
hoa.msg.affix_bulwark_text.zhCN: 为自身施加相当于其生命值{1}的护盾，旧护盾破碎或消失{2}后会获得新的护盾。

hoa.msg.affix_explosive_text.enUS: While you are near it, fire erupts around it every {1}. A red circle warns you first.
hoa.msg.affix_explosive_text.zhCN: 当你靠近它时，它的周围每{1}就会爆发一次火焰。爆发前会先出现红圈预警。

hoa.msg.affix_necrotic_text.enUS: Its attacks reduce your healing received. Stacks. Move away from it to clear.
hoa.msg.affix_necrotic_text.zhCN: 它的每次攻击都会降低你受到的治疗效果，且效果可以叠加。远离它即可清除该效果。

hoa.msg.affix_raging_text.enUS: Deals {1} more damage when below {2} health.
hoa.msg.affix_raging_text.zhCN: 生命值低于{2}时，造成的伤害提高{1}。

hoa.msg.affix_sanguine_text.enUS: When it dies, it leaves a pool that heals enemies standing in it.
hoa.msg.affix_sanguine_text.zhCN: 它死亡时会留下一滩血池，治疗站在其中的敌人。

hoa.msg.affix_vampiric_text.enUS: Heals for {1} of the damage it deals.
hoa.msg.affix_vampiric_text.zhCN: 按其造成伤害的{1}恢复自身生命值。

hoa.msg.affix_volcanic_text.enUS: Now and then, fire erupts under you. A red circle warns you first.
hoa.msg.affix_volcanic_text.zhCN: 你的脚下会不时爆发火焰。爆发前会先出现红圈预警。

hoa.msg.all_enemies_and_dummies_are.enUS: All enemies and dummies are gone.
hoa.msg.all_enemies_and_dummies_are.zhCN: 所有敌人和木桩都消失了。

hoa.msg.all_your_cooldowns_are_ready.zhCN: 你所有的技能都已就绪。

hoa.msg.already_highest_rank.enUS: {1} is already at its highest rank.

hoa.msg.already_in_a_run.enUS: You are already in a run.

hoa.msg.altar_guardians_arrive_in.zhCN: 祭坛的守卫将在{1}后到来。

hoa.msg.ascension_reveals_evolution.enUS: {1} is consumed and reveals the evolution of {2}.

hoa.msg.ban_only_unlocked.enUS: You can only ban Darkmoon Cards and Glyphs you have unlocked.
hoa.msg.ban_only_unlocked.zhCN: 你只能禁用已解锁的暗月卡片和雕文。

hoa.msg.bench_mode_is_on_talents.enUS: Bench mode is on: talents, account upgrades and gear don't count until you leave the sandbox.
hoa.msg.bench_mode_is_on_talents.zhCN: 练习模式已开启：在你离开沙盒之前，天赋、账号升级和装备都不会生效。

hoa.msg.boss_is_already_due.zhCN: 已经到首领登场的时间了。

hoa.msg.boss_training_dummy_ready.enUS: A boss training dummy stands ready.
hoa.msg.boss_training_dummy_ready.zhCN: 一个首领训练木桩已就绪。

hoa.msg.bosses_here_are_at_health.zhCN: 这里的首领生命值现为{1}%。

hoa.msg.bounty_is_out_on_kill.enUS: A bounty is out on {1}! Kill it within {2} seconds to earn a chest.
hoa.msg.bounty_is_out_on_kill.zhCN: {1}身上有赏金！在{2}秒内击杀它即可获得一个宝箱。

hoa.msg.cant_banish_owned.enUS: You can't banish something you already have.
hoa.msg.cant_banish_owned.zhCN: 你不能放逐已经拥有的东西。

hoa.msg.cant_be_learned_with.enUS: {1} can't be learned alongside {2}. Unlearn {2} first.

hoa.msg.cant_change_pool_during_run.enUS: You can't ban or allow Darkmoon Cards and Glyphs during a run.
hoa.msg.cant_change_pool_during_run.zhCN: 你不能在远征中禁用或允许暗月卡片和雕文。

hoa.msg.cant_do_that_during_run.enUS: You can't do that during a run.
hoa.msg.cant_do_that_during_run.zhCN: 你不能在远征中这样做。

hoa.msg.cant_enter_sandbox_in_combat.enUS: You can't enter the sandbox while in combat.
hoa.msg.cant_enter_sandbox_in_combat.zhCN: 你不能在战斗中进入沙盒。

hoa.msg.cant_enter_sandbox_while_flying.enUS: You can't enter the sandbox while flying.
hoa.msg.cant_enter_sandbox_while_flying.zhCN: 你不能在飞行中进入沙盒。

hoa.msg.cant_go_back_to_inn.enUS: You can't go back to the Inn right now.

hoa.msg.cant_start_run_in_combat.enUS: You can't start a run while in combat.
hoa.msg.cant_start_run_in_combat.zhCN: 你不能在战斗中开始远征。

hoa.msg.cant_start_run_now.enUS: You can't start a run right now.

hoa.msg.cant_start_run_while_dead.enUS: You can't start a run while dead.
hoa.msg.cant_start_run_while_dead.zhCN: 你不能在死亡状态下开始远征。

hoa.msg.cant_start_run_while_flying.enUS: You can't start a run while flying.
hoa.msg.cant_start_run_while_flying.zhCN: 你不能在飞行中开始远征。

hoa.msg.cant_use_that_right_now.enUS: You can't use that right now.

hoa.msg.caravan_about_to_fall.enUS: The caravan is about to fall!

hoa.msg.caravan_made_it_across_and.enUS: The caravan made it across and left you a chest!
hoa.msg.caravan_made_it_across_and.zhCN: 商队成功穿越，给你留下了一个宝箱！

hoa.msg.card_ascension_ready.enUS: Your next level-up offers the evolution of {1}.
hoa.msg.card_ascension_ready.zhCN: 你下次升级时会提供{1}的进化。

hoa.msg.card_ban_slots_in_use.enUS: All your Darkmoon Card ban slots are in use. Allow a banned card first, or earn another slot.
hoa.msg.card_ban_slots_in_use.zhCN: 你的暗月卡片禁用栏位已全部用完。请先重新允许一张已禁用的卡片，或再获得一个栏位。

hoa.msg.card_turkey_legs.enUS: +{1}% turkey leg drops, +{2}% turkey leg healing

hoa.msg.challenge_altar_yields_its_treas.enUS: The Challenge Altar yields its treasure!
hoa.msg.challenge_altar_yields_its_treas.zhCN: 挑战祭坛献出了它的宝藏！

hoa.msg.charge_banish_text.enUS: +1 Banish. Removes a choice for the rest of the run.
hoa.msg.charge_banish_text.zhCN: 使你多获得1次放逐，可将一个选项从本次远征中永久移除。

hoa.msg.charge_reroll_text.enUS: +1 Reroll. Draws new choices on a level-up or chest.
hoa.msg.charge_reroll_text.zhCN: 使你多获得1次重选，可在升级或开启宝箱时重新抽取选项。

hoa.msg.charge_skip_text.enUS: +1 Skip. Passes on a choice for a little Valor.
hoa.msg.charge_skip_text.zhCN: 使你多获得1次跳过，可放弃一次选择以换取少量勇气点数。

hoa.msg.choose_something_still_for_sale.zhCN: 请选择仍在出售的商品。

hoa.msg.class_reworked_no_run.enUS: The {1} class is being reworked and can't start runs yet.
hoa.msg.class_reworked_no_run.zhCN: {1}职业正在重做，暂时无法开始远征。

hoa.msg.class_reworked_no_sandbox.enUS: The {1} class is being reworked and can't enter the sandbox yet.
hoa.msg.class_reworked_no_sandbox.zhCN: {1}职业正在重做，暂时无法进入沙盒。

hoa.msg.clear_first_to_unlock_its.enUS: Clear {1} first to unlock its challenges.
hoa.msg.clear_first_to_unlock_its.zhCN: 请先通关{1}难度以解锁其挑战。

hoa.msg.clear_heroic_to_unlock_ranks.enUS: Clear Heroic to unlock ranks {1} to {2}.
hoa.msg.clear_heroic_to_unlock_ranks.zhCN: 通关英雄难度即可解锁{1}到{2}级。

hoa.msg.clear_level_to_raise.zhCN: 通关{1}后才能将其提升至{2}。

hoa.msg.cleared_stage_take_portal.enUS: You cleared stage {1}! Take the portal to the next stage, or return to the Inn.
hoa.msg.cleared_stage_take_portal.zhCN: 你通关了第{1}阶段！从传送门进入下一阶段，或返回旅店。

hoa.msg.coop_another_chance.enUS: The new revive gives fallen players another chance. Stand in their ring to bring them back.
hoa.msg.coop_another_chance.zhCN: 新的复活机会让倒下的玩家再获一次机会。站进他们的法环即可将其复活。

hoa.msg.coop_bank_at_home.enUS: Your bank stays in your own game. Use it when you're back home.
hoa.msg.coop_bank_at_home.zhCN: 你的银行保留在你自己的游戏中。回家后再使用它。

hoa.msg.coop_chests_closed_after_down.enUS: You were down when the boss died. Chests and shrines open again next stage.
hoa.msg.coop_chests_closed_after_down.zhCN: 首领死亡时你处于倒地状态。宝箱和神龛将在下一阶段重新对你开启。

hoa.msg.coop_choice_timed_out.enUS: Time's up. A choice was made for you.
hoa.msg.coop_choice_timed_out.zhCN: 时间到。系统已替你做出选择。

hoa.msg.coop_class_taken.enUS: Your party already has this class. Join with a character of another class.
hoa.msg.coop_class_taken.zhCN: 你的队伍中已有这个职业。请换用其他职业的角色加入。

hoa.msg.coop_group_wiped.enUS: Your whole party is down. The run is over.
hoa.msg.coop_group_wiped.zhCN: 你的整个队伍都倒下了。远征结束。

hoa.msg.coop_host_fortunes.enUS: In co-op, the host's Dark Fortunes count for everyone.
hoa.msg.coop_host_fortunes.zhCN: 在联机合作中，房主的黑暗运势对所有人有效。

hoa.msg.coop_host_ironman.enUS: The host is playing an ironman character. Ironman characters can't play co-op.
hoa.msg.coop_host_ironman.zhCN: 房主正在使用铁人角色。铁人角色无法进行联机合作。

hoa.msg.coop_host_next_stage.enUS: The host is moving the party to the next stage.
hoa.msg.coop_host_next_stage.zhCN: 房主将队伍带往下一阶段。

hoa.msg.coop_leave_from_menu.enUS: To leave a co-op game, use Leave game in the menu.
hoa.msg.coop_leave_from_menu.zhCN: 要离开联机游戏，请使用菜单中的“离开游戏”。

hoa.msg.coop_lost_connection.enUS: {1} disconnected. They have {2} minutes to reconnect.
hoa.msg.coop_lost_connection.zhCN: {1}已断开连接。他们有{2}分钟的时间重新连接。

hoa.msg.coop_member_down.enUS: {1} is downed! Stand next to them to revive them.
hoa.msg.coop_member_down.zhCN: {1}倒地了！站到他们身旁即可复活。

hoa.msg.coop_member_down_no_revives.enUS: {1} is downed, and your party has no revives left.
hoa.msg.coop_member_down_no_revives.zhCN: {1}倒地了，而你的队伍已没有复活机会。

hoa.msg.coop_next_stage_not_ready.enUS: {1} isn't ready. The party stays at the portal.
hoa.msg.coop_next_stage_not_ready.zhCN: {1}尚未就位。队伍将留在传送门处。

hoa.msg.coop_not_ready.enUS: {1} wasn't ready and stayed in town.

hoa.msg.coop_only_host_settings.enUS: Only the host can change party settings.
hoa.msg.coop_only_host_settings.zhCN: 只有房主可以更改队伍设置。

hoa.msg.coop_pause_turned_off.enUS: The host turned Pause off, so nobody waits while someone chooses. This takes effect next run.
hoa.msg.coop_pause_turned_off.zhCN: 房主关闭了暂停：有人在选择时，其他人不会等待。下次远征生效。

hoa.msg.coop_pause_turned_on.enUS: The host set Pause to Party, so everyone waits while someone chooses. This takes effect next run.
hoa.msg.coop_pause_turned_on.zhCN: 房主将暂停设为“队伍”：有人在选择时，所有人都会等待。下次远征生效。

hoa.msg.coop_raised_after_boss.enUS: You're back up. Chests and shrines stay closed to you this stage.
hoa.msg.coop_raised_after_boss.zhCN: 你重新站起来了。本阶段内，宝箱和神龛对你保持关闭。

hoa.msg.coop_removed.enUS: You were removed from the party.

hoa.msg.coop_setting_pause_off.enUS: Pause: Off. Nobody waits while someone chooses.
hoa.msg.coop_setting_pause_off.zhCN: 暂停：关闭。有人在选择时，其他人不会等待。

hoa.msg.coop_setting_pause_shared.enUS: Pause: Party. Everyone waits while someone chooses.
hoa.msg.coop_setting_pause_shared.zhCN: 暂停：队伍。有人在选择时，所有人都会等待。

hoa.msg.coop_setting_xp_own.enUS: XP: Individual. Everyone earns their own XP; XP magnets are off.
hoa.msg.coop_setting_xp_own.zhCN: 经验：个人。每个人各自获得经验；经验磁铁关闭。

hoa.msg.coop_setting_xp_shared.enUS: XP: Shared. The party levels together.
hoa.msg.coop_setting_xp_shared.zhCN: 经验：共享。全队一起升级。

hoa.msg.coop_stage_revive.enUS: Stage cleared! Your party gains a revive.
hoa.msg.coop_stage_revive.zhCN: 阶段通关！你的队伍获得了一次复活机会。

hoa.msg.coop_starts_without_loading.enUS: {1} is still loading. The run starts without them.
hoa.msg.coop_starts_without_loading.zhCN: {1}仍在加载。将不等待他们直接开始。

hoa.msg.coop_transfer_no_free_name.enUS: There is no free name for {1}.
hoa.msg.coop_transfer_no_free_name.zhCN: 没有可用于{1}的空闲名称。

hoa.msg.coop_transfer_old_copy.enUS: The old copy of the character couldn't be removed.
hoa.msg.coop_transfer_old_copy.zhCN: 无法移除该角色的旧副本。

hoa.msg.coop_transfer_other_account.enUS: That character belongs to another account.

hoa.msg.coop_transfer_progress_failed.enUS: Your account progress couldn't be loaded.
hoa.msg.coop_transfer_progress_failed.zhCN: 无法加载你的账号进度。

hoa.msg.coop_vault_not_yours.enUS: That Extraction Vault belongs to {1}. Yours is marked Your Vault.
hoa.msg.coop_vault_not_yours.zhCN: 那个提取保险库属于{1}。你自己的保险库上标有“你的保险库”字样。

hoa.msg.coop_wants_next_stage.enUS: {1} wants to go to the next stage.

hoa.msg.coop_xp_turned_own.enUS: The host set XP to Individual, so everyone earns their own XP and XP magnets are off. This takes effect next run.
hoa.msg.coop_xp_turned_own.zhCN: 房主将经验设为“个人”：每个人各自获得经验，经验磁铁将关闭。下次远征生效。

hoa.msg.coop_xp_turned_shared.enUS: The host set XP to Shared, so the party levels together. This takes effect next run.
hoa.msg.coop_xp_turned_shared.zhCN: 房主将经验设为“共享”：全队一起升级。下次远征生效。

hoa.msg.coop_you_down.enUS: You're downed! Stay near your party so they can revive you.
hoa.msg.coop_you_down.zhCN: 你倒地了！请待在队友附近，他们才能复活你。

hoa.msg.coop_you_down_no_revives.enUS: You're downed, and your party has no revives left.
hoa.msg.coop_you_down_no_revives.zhCN: 你倒地了，而你的队伍已没有复活机会。

hoa.msg.deck_empty_gold.enUS: The deck is empty, so you get {1} instead.
hoa.msg.deck_empty_gold.zhCN: 牌库已空，因此你改为获得{1}。

hoa.msg.deep_dummies_on.enUS: New dummies have 100 times the health and refill below half, so every hit counts on the meter.
hoa.msg.deep_dummies_on.zhCN: 新木桩的生命值为原来的100倍，并会在低于一半时回满，因此每次攻击都会计入伤害统计。

hoa.msg.demon_portal_is_destroyed_leavin.enUS: The demon portal is destroyed, leaving a chest behind!
hoa.msg.demon_portal_is_destroyed_leavin.zhCN: 恶魔传送门被摧毁，留下了一个宝箱！

hoa.msg.demon_portal_opens_destroy_it.enUS: A demon portal opens! Destroy it before it closes.
hoa.msg.demon_portal_opens_destroy_it.zhCN: 一道恶魔传送门开启了！在它关闭之前摧毁它。

hoa.msg.divine_shield_never.enUS: It won't be ready again this run.
hoa.msg.divine_shield_never.zhCN: 本次远征中它不会再次就绪。

hoa.msg.divine_shield_next_stage.enUS: It will be ready again next stage.
hoa.msg.divine_shield_next_stage.zhCN: 它将在下一阶段再次就绪。

hoa.msg.divine_shield_stages.enUS: It will be ready again in {1} stages.
hoa.msg.divine_shield_stages.zhCN: 它将在{1}个阶段后再次就绪。

hoa.msg.elite_training_dummy_ready.enUS: An elite training dummy stands ready.
hoa.msg.elite_training_dummy_ready.zhCN: 一个精英训练木桩已就绪。

hoa.msg.enchant_applied.enUS: Your gear now has a {1} enchant.
hoa.msg.enchant_applied.zhCN: 你的装备现在附有{1}附魔。

hoa.msg.enchant_costs_valor_you_have.enUS: An enchant costs {1} Valor. You have {2}.
hoa.msg.enchant_costs_valor_you_have.zhCN: 一次附魔需要{1}勇气点数。你目前拥有{2}点。

hoa.msg.enchanter_only_during_run.enUS: The enchanter only works during a run.
hoa.msg.enchanter_only_during_run.zhCN: 附魔师只在远征中提供服务。

hoa.msg.enemies_passive_on.enUS: Enemies are passive now: they don't move, attack or cast.
hoa.msg.enemies_passive_on.zhCN: 敌人现在处于被动状态：不会移动、攻击或施法。

hoa.msg.enemies_unkillable_on.zhCN: 敌人的生命值现在不会低于1点。

hoa.msg.enemy_blinks_to_you.enUS: {1} blinks to you if you stay out of range.
hoa.msg.enemy_blinks_to_you.zhCN: {1}会在你离得太远时闪现到你身边。

hoa.msg.enemy_bombards_you.enUS: {1} bombards you while you keep your distance.
hoa.msg.enemy_bombards_you.zhCN: 你保持距离时，{1}会对你进行轰炸。

hoa.msg.enemy_burns_outer_ring.enUS: {1} sets the ground around it ablaze. Only the space next to it is safe.
hoa.msg.enemy_burns_outer_ring.zhCN: {1}点燃了周围的地面。只有紧挨着它的地方是安全的。

hoa.msg.enemy_ground_erupts.enUS: {1} makes the ground erupt! Stand in the safe lane.
hoa.msg.enemy_ground_erupts.zhCN: {1}使地面成排喷发。站到不会喷发的那一排中。

hoa.msg.enemy_marks_you.enUS: {1} marks you. The mark bursts where you stand when it fades.
hoa.msg.enemy_marks_you.zhCN: {1}标记了你。标记消失时，会在你所站的位置爆炸。

hoa.msg.enemy_meteor_shower.enUS: {1} calls down a meteor shower. Find a path between the falling circles.
hoa.msg.enemy_meteor_shower.zhCN: {1}召唤了一场流星雨。请在坠落的圆圈之间找出一条安全路线。

hoa.msg.enemy_moves_off.enUS: Enemy moves are off: enemies only walk and swing.
hoa.msg.enemy_moves_off.zhCN: 敌人招式已关闭：敌人只会走动和近战攻击。

hoa.msg.enemy_raises_healing_wards.enUS: {1} raises healing wards. Destroy them before they heal it.
hoa.msg.enemy_raises_healing_wards.zhCN: {1}召唤出了治疗结界。在它们为其恢复生命之前将它们摧毁。

hoa.msg.enemy_raises_shield.enUS: {1} raises a shield! Break through it.

hoa.msg.enemy_recovers.zhCN: 你远离时，{1}会恢复生命值。

hoa.msg.event_demon_portal_text.enUS: Demons pour out until it is destroyed. Destroy it to earn a chest.
hoa.msg.event_demon_portal_text.zhCN: 恶魔会不断从中涌出，直到你将其摧毁。摧毁它即可获得一个宝箱。

hoa.msg.event_kobold_thief_text.enUS: It stole your experience. Kill it to get it back, plus a bonus.
hoa.msg.event_kobold_thief_text.zhCN: 它偷走了你的经验。击杀它即可取回，还能获得额外奖励。

hoa.msg.event_kodo_caravan_text.enUS: Protect it from raiders until it gets across to earn a chest with extra choices.
hoa.msg.event_kodo_caravan_text.zhCN: 在它穿越这片区域前别让袭击者靠近，它就会给你留下一个有额外选项的宝箱。

hoa.msg.event_necrotic_shard_text.enUS: It raises undead until you destroy it. Each shard you destroy gives Valor and experience.

hoa.msg.refund_first_because_it_requires.enUS: {1} requires this talent. Refund it first.

hoa.msg.refunded_rank_got_back.enUS: You refunded rank {1} of {2} and got {3} back.

hoa.msg.refunded_rank_talent_point.enUS: You refunded rank {1} of {2} and got 1 talent point back.
hoa.msg.refunded_rank_talent_point.zhCN: 你退还了{2}第{1}级，取回了1个天赋点。

hoa.msg.refunded_talent_point.enUS: You refunded {1} and got 1 talent point back.
hoa.msg.refunded_talent_point.zhCN: 你退还了{1}，取回了1个天赋点。

hoa.msg.requires_points_in_this_tree.zhCN: 需要在此天赋树中投入{1}点。

hoa.msg.reroll_costs_valor_you_have.enUS: A reroll costs {1} Valor. You have {2}.
hoa.msg.reroll_costs_valor_you_have.zhCN: 补货需要{1}勇气点数。你目前拥有{2}点。

hoa.msg.reroll_stat_again.enUS: Reroll the stat again to get new choices.
hoa.msg.reroll_stat_again.zhCN: 再次重选该属性以获得新的选项。

hoa.msg.reward_card_ban_one.zhCN: 一个暗月卡片禁用栏位

hoa.msg.reward_unlocks_capstone.enUS: Unlocks {1}, the final talent in its tree
hoa.msg.reward_unlocks_capstone.zhCN: 解锁{1}（其天赋树的最终天赋）

hoa.msg.ring_fills_with_loot.enUS: Stand in the ring when it fills in {1} seconds, then open the vault to send one item home.
hoa.msg.ring_fills_with_loot.zhCN: 法环将在{1}秒后填满。填满时站在其中，然后打开保险库，即可送1件装备回家。

hoa.msg.rule_agony.enUS: each stack deals {1}% of base health every tick for {2}, growing to 3 times as strong over 8 ticks. It doesn't spread on death.
hoa.msg.rule_agony.zhCN: 每层每跳造成基础生命值{1}%的伤害，持续{2}，并在8跳内逐渐增强至3倍。目标死亡时不会蔓延。

hoa.msg.rule_area.enUS: bigger AoE spells. Diminishing returns, up to {1}%. Doesn't affect other spells or summons.
hoa.msg.rule_area.zhCN: 扩大范围法术的作用范围。收益递减，最多{1}%。不影响其他法术或召唤物。

hoa.msg.rule_armor.enUS: 20 Armor reduces damage taken by 16%, 100 Armor by 43%, and 300 Armor by 60%, the most it can. Each point above 300 gives +0.5% maximum health.
hoa.msg.rule_armor.zhCN: 20点护甲使受到的伤害降低16%，100点护甲降低43%，300点护甲降低60%，此为上限。超过300的每点护甲提供+0.5%最大生命值。

hoa.msg.rule_base_health.enUS: the health of a normal enemy of the zone's level on Normal. It doesn't grow with difficulty, stages, elites or bosses.
hoa.msg.rule_base_health.zhCN: 普通难度下与该区域等级相同的普通敌人的生命值。它不会随难度、阶段、精英或首领而提高。

hoa.msg.rule_chill.enUS: {1}% slow per stack, up to {2}. At {2} stacks the enemy is Frozen.
hoa.msg.rule_chill.zhCN: 每层减速{1}%，最多{2}层。达到{2}层时，敌人会被冻结。

hoa.msg.rule_cooldown.enUS: shortened by Haste, including the spell's own Haste upgrades. Never below 0.2 sec. A spell with no target in range waits instead of starting its cooldown.
hoa.msg.rule_cooldown.zhCN: 受急速缩短，其中包括法术自身的急速强化。最低0.2秒。范围内没有目标的法术会等待，而不是进入冷却。

hoa.msg.rule_count.enUS: +1 bolt, shot, swing, pet or totem per point, up to {1}. Other AoE spells ignore it.
hoa.msg.rule_count.zhCN: 每点使飞弹、射击、挥击、宠物或图腾的数量+1，最多+{1}。其他范围法术不受其影响。

hoa.msg.rule_crit_chance.enUS: {1}% base. Spells crit for 150% damage, attacks for 200%. Above 100%, a hit can crit twice. At 200% every hit crits twice, and more does nothing.
hoa.msg.rule_crit_chance.zhCN: 基础为{1}%。法术的致命一击造成150%伤害，攻击造成200%伤害。几率超过100%时，一次命中可以造成两次致命一击。达到200%时，每次命中都会造成两次致命一击，再高也没有效果。

hoa.msg.rule_crit_damage.zhCN: 每点使致命一击伤害提高1%。

hoa.msg.rule_damage_order.enUS: Damage you take is reduced by Dodge, then damage reduction, then Armor, then Shield.
hoa.msg.rule_damage_order.zhCN: 你受到的伤害会依次经过闪避、伤害减免、护甲和护盾的削减。

hoa.msg.rule_dash_immune.enUS: Dash makes you immune to damage for 0.25 sec.
hoa.msg.rule_dash_immune.zhCN: 冲刺会使你在0.25秒内免疫伤害。

hoa.msg.rule_dazed.enUS: {1}% slow for {2}. Only the strongest slow counts.
hoa.msg.rule_dazed.zhCN: 减速{1}%，持续{2}。只有效果最强的减速生效。

hoa.msg.rule_determination.enUS: each run that ends in death before your first Normal clear gives +{1} Power and {1}% less damage taken, up to {2} stacks.
hoa.msg.rule_determination.zhCN: 在你首次通关普通难度之前，每次以死亡告终的远征都会使你获得+{1}力量，并使受到的伤害降低{1}%，最多叠加{2}层。

hoa.msg.rule_dodge.enUS: chance to dodge enemy melee attacks, up to {1}%. Evasion and Deterrence go past the cap.
hoa.msg.rule_dodge.zhCN: 闪避敌人近战攻击的几率，最多{1}%。“闪避”和“威慑”技能可以超过上限。

hoa.msg.rule_dot_bosses.enUS: Stacks deal the same damage to bosses, which is a smaller share of their health.
hoa.msg.rule_dot_bosses.zhCN: 首领每层受到的伤害相同，只是占其生命值的比例更小。

hoa.msg.rule_dot_burst.enUS: When a burning, bleeding or poisoned enemy dies, its remaining damage over time bursts onto up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, each taking half.
hoa.msg.rule_dot_burst.zhCN: 燃烧、流血或中毒的敌人死亡时，其层数剩余的伤害会爆发到8码内最多4个敌人身上，每个承受一半。

hoa.msg.rule_dot_crit.enUS: Damage over time can critically strike only with a talent, for half the usual critical strike bonus.
hoa.msg.rule_dot_crit.zhCN: 只有拥有相应天赋时，持续伤害才能造成致命一击，且致命一击的伤害加成只有通常的一半。

hoa.msg.rule_dot_leech.enUS: Ticks can trigger Leech. They don't trigger cards or trinkets.
hoa.msg.rule_dot_leech.zhCN: 每跳伤害可以触发吸血，但不会触发卡片或饰品。

hoa.msg.rule_dot_power.enUS: Damage over time updates with your Power when a stack is added or expires. Vulnerabilities apply to every tick.
hoa.msg.rule_dot_power.zhCN: 持续伤害在层数增加或消失时会按你的力量更新。易伤效果对每一跳生效。

hoa.msg.rule_dot_refresh.enUS: Each new stack refreshes all stacks on that enemy.
hoa.msg.rule_dot_refresh.zhCN: 每叠加新的一层，都会刷新该敌人身上的所有层数。

hoa.msg.rule_dot_spread.enUS: When an enemy with 2 or more stacks dies, half its stacks spread to the 2 nearest enemies within 8 yards.
hoa.msg.rule_dot_spread.zhCN: 拥有2层或以上效果的敌人死亡时，其一半的层数会蔓延至8码内最近的2个敌人。

hoa.msg.rule_dot_stacks.enUS: Burning, Bleed, Poison, Decay and Moonfire: each stack deals {1}% of base health every tick for {2}, up to {3} stacks.
hoa.msg.rule_dot_stacks.zhCN: 燃烧、流血、中毒、腐朽和月火术：每层每跳造成基础生命值{1}%的伤害，持续{2}，最多{3}层。

hoa.msg.rule_dot_tick.enUS: Damage over time ticks every second, faster with Haste.
hoa.msg.rule_dot_tick.zhCN: 持续伤害每秒跳动一次，急速可使其更快。

hoa.msg.rule_epic_upgrades.enUS: Hit Twice, Echo and Targets come only from Epic ranks.
hoa.msg.rule_epic_upgrades.zhCN: 双重打击、回响和目标数强化只会来自史诗等级。

hoa.msg.rule_evolutions.enUS: Evolutions can be offered from rank 10, or earlier with Premonition. An evolved spell keeps its rank, damage and upgrades. Blade Flurry, Shadow Dance and Evasion start at max rank; their evolutions can be offered once your other spells total 20 ranks.
hoa.msg.rule_evolutions.zhCN: 从10级起，升级时可能提供进化；拥有预感时会更早出现。进化后的法术会保留其等级、伤害和强化。剑刃乱舞、暗影之舞和闪避学会时即为最高等级；当你的其他法术总等级达到20级后，才会提供它们的进化。

hoa.msg.rule_fear.enUS: Fear and charm don't work on elites or bosses.
hoa.msg.rule_fear.zhCN: 恐惧和魅惑对精英和首领无效。

hoa.msg.rule_frozen.enUS: normal enemies are rooted for {1}; elites and bosses keep moving but count as Frozen. Your Frost spells always crit Frozen enemies, and you deal +50% critical strike damage to them.
hoa.msg.rule_frozen.zhCN: 普通敌人被定身{1}；精英和首领仍可移动，但视为冻结。你的冰霜法术对冻结的敌人必定造成致命一击，且你对其造成的致命一击伤害提高50%。

hoa.msg.rule_gear_quality.enUS: Higher Mythic levels drop gear with a higher Item Level. Each drop's quality is random: green gear has 1 bonus stat, blue gear has 10% more stats and 1 or 2 bonus stats, and epic gear has 45% more stats than white and at least 1 bonus stat. Legendaries have epic stats and a unique effect. From the same level, an epic always beats a blue; compare gear from different levels by Item Level.
hoa.msg.rule_gear_quality.zhCN: 史诗等级越高，其掉落装备的物品等级就越高。品质在每次掉落时随机决定：绿色装备有1条额外属性，蓝色装备属性多10%并有1至2条额外属性，史诗装备比白色装备多45%属性，且至少有1条额外属性。传说装备拥有史诗属性和一个独特效果。同一级别下，史诗装备总是胜过蓝色装备；来自不同级别的装备请按物品等级比较。

hoa.msg.rule_gear_rolls.enUS: From Mythic 11, bonus stats roll in the top half of their range; from Mythic 16, in the top quarter.
hoa.msg.rule_gear_rolls.zhCN: 从史诗11级起，额外属性会在其范围的上半段内随机；从史诗16级起，则在上四分之一段内随机。

hoa.msg.rule_gear_stats.enUS: Gear gives its listed stats plus its bonus stats.
hoa.msg.rule_gear_stats.zhCN: 装备提供其所列属性以及额外属性。

hoa.msg.rule_gear_tiers.enUS: Every piece has an Item Level. A higher Item Level gives more Power, Max Health and Armor, whatever the quality; twice the Item Level doubles them. Other stats don't change.
hoa.msg.rule_gear_tiers.zhCN: 每件装备都有物品等级：无论品质如何，物品等级越高，提供的力量、最大生命值和护甲就越多。物品等级翻倍，这些属性也翻倍。其他属性保持不变。

hoa.msg.rule_glyph_damage.enUS: Glyph damage (Storm, Meteor, Shadowmourne) grows with base health, Power and run time, but not with difficulty. Storm always crits.
hoa.msg.rule_glyph_damage.zhCN: 雕文伤害（风暴、陨石、影之哀伤）随基础生命值、远征时长和力量提高，与难度无关。风暴必定造成致命一击。

hoa.msg.rule_gold.enUS: more gold. Doesn't affect Valor or Darkmoon Tickets.
hoa.msg.rule_gold.zhCN: 获得更多金币。不影响勇气点数和暗月奖券。

hoa.msg.rule_haste.enUS: shorter cooldowns and faster damage over time. Diminishing returns, up to {1}%. Gear gives at most {2}%. Short Haste boosts go past the cap.
hoa.msg.rule_haste.zhCN: 缩短冷却时间，并使持续伤害跳得更快。收益递减，最多{1}%。装备最多提供{2}%。短暂的急速提升可以超过上限。

hoa.msg.rule_healing_cuts.enUS: Necrotic, boss wounds and Cursed Ground reduce healing taken, up to 100%.
hoa.msg.rule_healing_cuts.zhCN: 死疽、首领造成的创伤和诅咒之地会降低受到的治疗效果，最多降低100%。

hoa.msg.rule_healing_orbs.enUS: Healing orbs heal 20% of maximum health. Each level gained heals 5%.
hoa.msg.rule_healing_orbs.zhCN: 治疗球恢复20%最大生命值。每次升级恢复5%。

hoa.msg.rule_health_regeneration.enUS: heals 1% of maximum health per second per point. Healing cuts reduce it.
hoa.msg.rule_health_regeneration.zhCN: 每点每秒恢复1%最大生命值。治疗削减效果会使其降低。

hoa.msg.rule_hit_spread.enUS: Spell damage varies by up to 7%, pet damage by up to 10%. Damage over time doesn't vary.
hoa.msg.rule_hit_spread.zhCN: 法术伤害的浮动幅度最多为7%，宠物伤害最多为10%。持续伤害不会浮动。

hoa.msg.rule_hunters_mark.enUS: marked enemies take {1}% more damage from you and your summons, up to 30% with ranks and Mark upgrades. Talents add more. When a marked enemy dies, the mark passes to the 2 nearest unmarked enemies within 10 yards.
hoa.msg.rule_hunters_mark.zhCN: 被标记的敌人受到你和你的召唤物造成的伤害提高{1}%，施加标记的法术的等级和标记强化可将其最多提高至30%。天赋效果额外叠加。目标死亡时，标记会转移到10码内最近的2个未被标记的敌人身上。

hoa.msg.rule_judged.enUS: enemies hit by Judgement of the Crusader take 20% more damage from you for 6 sec.
hoa.msg.rule_judged.zhCN: 被十字军审判击中的敌人受到你造成的伤害提高20%，持续6秒。

hoa.msg.rule_knockbacks.enUS: Knockbacks and pulls work only on normal enemies. The enemy is then immune to knockbacks for 6 sec, or to pulls for 3 sec.
hoa.msg.rule_knockbacks.zhCN: 击退只对普通敌人有效，之后免疫6秒。牵引只对普通敌人有效，之后免疫3秒。

hoa.msg.rule_leech.enUS: your hits have a 1% chance per point to heal 1% of maximum health, up to 0.06% of maximum health per second per point. Summon hits don't count.
hoa.msg.rule_leech.zhCN: 每点使你的命中有1%几率恢复1%最大生命值，每点每秒最多恢复0.06%最大生命值。召唤物的命中不计入。

hoa.msg.rule_luck.enUS: rarer level-up, card, glyph and Ley Line choices. +0.1% elite chest chance and +0.1% evolution chance per point.
hoa.msg.rule_luck.zhCN: 提高升级、卡片、雕文和魔网选项的稀有度。每点使精英掉落宝箱的几率+0.1%，进化几率+0.1%。

hoa.msg.rule_max_health.zhCN: 每点使最大生命值提高1%。

hoa.msg.rule_movement_speed.enUS: 10% base, +1% per point, up to {1}%. Short speed boosts go past it.
hoa.msg.rule_movement_speed.zhCN: 基础为10%，每点+1%，最多{1}%。短暂的加速效果可以超过此上限。

hoa.msg.rule_pickup_range.enUS: 6 yards base, +1% per point, up to 30 yards. Darkmoon Tickets and Glyphs are always picked up within 3 yards.
hoa.msg.rule_pickup_range.zhCN: 基础6码，每点+1%，最多30码。暗月奖券和雕文始终可在3码内拾取。

hoa.msg.rule_power.enUS: +1% damage per point, for you and your summons. Power on gear gives +0.5% per point and multiplies with your other Power.
hoa.msg.rule_power.zhCN: 每点使你和你的召唤物造成的伤害提高1%。装备上的力量每点提供0.5%，并与你的其他力量相乘。

hoa.msg.rule_proc_chains.enUS: Procs never trigger other trinkets or cards. Their hits can trigger Leech.
hoa.msg.rule_proc_chains.zhCN: 触发效果永远不会触发其他饰品或卡片。它们的命中可以触发吸血。

hoa.msg.rule_proc_next_hit.enUS: Fire Burst, Shadow Burst, Chain Lightning and Death Ray can trigger when you cast a spell and strike with that spell's next hit.
hoa.msg.rule_proc_next_hit.zhCN: 火焰爆发、暗影爆发、闪电链和死亡射线在施放法术时判定，并在该法术的下一次命中时触发。

hoa.msg.rule_ranks.enUS: Common +{1}% damage, Uncommon +{2}%, Rare +{3}% and 1 upgrade, Epic +{4}% and 2 upgrades. Spells without damage get upgrades instead. Past rank 20 the damage per rank shrinks: rank 40 adds half, rank 80 a quarter.
hoa.msg.rule_ranks.zhCN: 普通+{1}%伤害，优秀+{2}%，精良+{3}%并获得1项强化，史诗+{4}%并获得2项强化。没有伤害的法术改为获得强化。超过20级后，每级增加的伤害逐渐减少：到40级时为一半，到80级时为四分之一。

hoa.msg.rule_revives.enUS: when you die, Glyph of Divine Shield saves you first, then Second Chance, then a Soulstone. A revive restores your health, shields you and destroys normal enemies within 15 yards.
hoa.msg.rule_revives.zhCN: 你死亡时，首先由圣盾术雕文救你，其次是第二次机会，最后是灵魂石。复活会恢复你的生命值，为你施加护盾，并消灭15码内的普通敌人。

hoa.msg.rule_roots.enUS: Roots work only on normal enemies and last at most 2 sec. The enemy is then immune to roots for 6 sec. Frozen shares this timer.
hoa.msg.rule_roots.zhCN: 定身只对普通敌人有效，最多持续2秒，之后免疫6秒。冻结与其共用此计时。

hoa.msg.rule_scrap.enUS: items you don't extract from a run turn into Scrap, more for higher Item Levels and more bonus stats. Elites drop a little too. Spend it at Durgan Ironbelly to upgrade a piece up to 3 times, one Mythic level each time, never past the highest level you have cleared. For gold, he rerolls one bonus stat per item.
hoa.msg.rule_scrap.zhCN: 每次远征中你没有提取的物品都会提供废料，物品等级越高、额外属性越多，提供的越多。精英也会掉落少量废料。德尔冈·铁腹可以用废料将一件装备最多升级3次，每次提升一个史诗等级，且永远不会超过你已通关的最高级别。支付金币后，他可以为每件物品重选一项额外属性。

hoa.msg.rule_shield.enUS: absorbs damage up to a share of maximum health. Refills after {1} without taking damage. All shields together hold at most 50% of maximum health, 100% with Juggernaut.
hoa.msg.rule_shield.zhCN: 吸收最多相当于最大生命值一定比例的伤害。{1}内未受到伤害后重新充满。所有护盾合计最多吸收相当于最大生命值50%的伤害，拥有重装碾压时为100%。

hoa.msg.rule_slots.enUS: You start with 3 spell slots and 3 passive slots. Sayge sells more, up to 5 spells and 6 passives.
hoa.msg.rule_slots.zhCN: 你初始拥有3个法术槽位和3个被动技能槽位。塞格出售更多槽位，最多5个法术和6个被动技能。

hoa.msg.rule_stacking_caps.enUS: Critical strike chance has no cap.
hoa.msg.rule_stacking_caps.zhCN: 致命一击几率没有上限。

hoa.msg.rule_stacking_copies.enUS: Each passive rank, extra card copy and Ley Line blessing of the same stat is worth 85% of the one before, never below 10%. Count always adds in full, and Rested can drop below 10%.
hoa.msg.rule_stacking_copies.zhCN: 同一属性的被动技能每一级、每多一张相同的卡片和每个魔网祝福，效果为前一个的85%，但不低于10%。数量始终全额累加，而休憩可能低于10%。

hoa.msg.rule_stacking_power.enUS: Talent damage bonuses add to Power. Spell ranks, Hunter's Mark, Judged, keyword payoffs and capstones multiply with it.
hoa.msg.rule_stacking_power.zhCN: 天赋的伤害加成计入力量。法术等级、猎人印记、被审判、关键词收益和终极天赋与其相乘。

hoa.msg.rule_stacking_target.enUS: Vulnerabilities and Sunder Armor multiply with everything else.
hoa.msg.rule_stacking_target.zhCN: 易伤和破甲与其他所有加成相乘。

hoa.msg.rule_stacking_total.enUS: Stats from gear, cards, glyphs, passives, talents, Training and Ley Lines add together. Caps apply to the total.
hoa.msg.rule_stacking_total.zhCN: 来自装备、卡片、雕文、被动技能、天赋、训练和魔网的属性会相加。上限作用于总值。

hoa.msg.rule_stacking_trinkets.enUS: Two trinkets with the same effect don't stack it.
hoa.msg.rule_stacking_trinkets.zhCN: 两件特效相同的饰品，其特效不会叠加。

hoa.msg.rule_static.enUS: at {1} stacks, lightning strikes the enemy and up to 3 enemies within 6 yards for {2}% of base health, raised by Power. It can crit.
hoa.msg.rule_static.zhCN: 达到{1}层时，闪电会打击该敌人及其6码内最多3个敌人，造成基础生命值{2}%的伤害，受力量加成。可以造成致命一击。

hoa.msg.rule_stuns.enUS: Stuns last at most 2 sec, then the enemy can't be stunned for 6 sec. Bosses and mini-bosses can't be stunned.
hoa.msg.rule_stuns.zhCN: 昏迷最多持续2秒，之后该敌人在6秒内无法再被昏迷。首领和小首领无法被昏迷。

hoa.msg.rule_summon_count.enUS: Count adds pets, elementals, treants, totems and wolves.
hoa.msg.rule_summon_count.zhCN: 数量可增加宠物、元素、树人、图腾和狼。

hoa.msg.rule_summon_duration.enUS: Summons that leave on their own, like snakes, beasts, Stampede, Spirit Pack wolves and warlock demons, last longer with Duration.
hoa.msg.rule_summon_duration.zhCN: 会自行消失的召唤物（如毒蛇、野兽、兽群奔腾、灵魂之群的狼和术士的恶魔）受持续时间加成，存在时间更长。

hoa.msg.rule_summon_keyword.enUS: Summon hits apply their spell's effects, like Burning or Chill.
hoa.msg.rule_summon_keyword.zhCN: 召唤物的每次命中都会施加其法术的效果，例如燃烧或冰寒。

hoa.msg.rule_summon_limits.enUS: Summons don't get your Area. Their hits don't trigger Leech, trinkets or on-hit cards, but their kills count.
hoa.msg.rule_summon_limits.zhCN: 召唤物不继承你的范围。它们的命中不会触发吸血、饰品或命中触发的卡片，但它们的击杀会计入。

hoa.msg.rule_summon_stats.enUS: Summons get your Power, critical strike chance and damage, Haste and Movement Speed. They never die and enemies ignore them.
hoa.msg.rule_summon_stats.zhCN: 召唤物继承你的力量、致命一击几率和致命一击伤害、急速以及移动速度。它们永远不会死亡，敌人也会无视它们。

hoa.msg.rule_trinket_tiers.enUS: Trinket effects don't grow with Item Level; their stats do.
hoa.msg.rule_trinket_tiers.zhCN: 饰品的特效不随物品等级提高，但其属性会提高。

hoa.msg.rule_trinkets.enUS: 5% chance when a spell is cast, at most once per cooldown. Damage trinkets deal a share of that spell's next hit, more with Count, and can crit. Area doesn't affect them.
hoa.msg.rule_trinkets.zhCN: 施放法术时有5%几率触发，每个冷却周期最多一次。伤害类饰品按该法术下一次命中伤害的一定比例造成伤害，数量越多伤害越高，并且可以造成致命一击。范围不影响它们。

hoa.msg.rule_vulnerabilities.enUS: Fire +{1}%, Shadow +{2}%, Nature +{3}% and Sunder Armor (Physical) +{4}% damage taken per stack, up to 5 stacks.
hoa.msg.rule_vulnerabilities.zhCN: 火焰易伤每层使受到的伤害提高{1}%，暗影易伤{2}%，自然易伤{3}%，破甲（物理）{4}%，最多5层。

hoa.msg.run_end_chat_defeat.zhCN: 你被击败了。你到达了第{1}阶段，本次远征位于{2}，取得{3}次击杀，等级为{4}，并获得了{5}和{6}。

hoa.msg.run_end_chat_home.zhCN: 远征完成！你到达了第{1}阶段，本次远征位于{2}，取得{3}次击杀，等级为{4}，并获得了{5}和{6}。

hoa.msg.run_end_chat_victory.enUS: Victory! You reached stage {1} in {2} with {3} kills at level {4}, and earned {5} and {6}.
hoa.msg.run_end_chat_victory.zhCN: 胜利！你到达了第{1}阶段，本次远征位于{2}，取得{3}次击杀，等级为{4}，并获得了{5}和{6}。

hoa.msg.sandbox_toughness_minute.enUS: New enemies are as tough as at minute {1} of a run.
hoa.msg.sandbox_toughness_minute.zhCN: 新敌人的强度相当于远征第{1}分钟时的水平。

hoa.msg.sandbox_toughness_time.enUS: Enemy toughness follows your time in the sandbox again.
hoa.msg.sandbox_toughness_time.zhCN: 敌人强度重新根据你在沙盒中的时间计算。

hoa.msg.shrine_challenge_altar_text.enUS: Click it to face elite guards with two affixes. Beat them for a free chest.

hoa.msg.shrine_greed_totem_text.enUS: Gain 5% more gold and Darkmoon Tickets for the rest of the run, but more enemies attack. Each totem you use adds to both.
hoa.msg.shrine_greed_totem_text.zhCN: 本次远征剩余时间内获得的金币和暗月奖券提高5%，但会有更多敌人来袭。每使用一个图腾，两种效果都会进一步叠加。

hoa.msg.shrine_ley_line_text.enUS: Stand in its ring for 8 seconds to choose a blessing for the rest of the run.
hoa.msg.shrine_ley_line_text.zhCN: 在它的法环中站立8秒，即可选择一项祝福，效果持续至本次远征结束。

hoa.msg.shrine_moonwell_text.enUS: Click it to heal 8% of your health every second for 10 seconds while you stand in it. Enemies that die inside it give double experience.
hoa.msg.shrine_moonwell_text.zhCN: 点击它后，站在其中时每秒恢复8%生命值，持续10秒。在其中死亡的敌人提供双倍经验值。

hoa.msg.shrine_summoning_stone_text.enUS: Click it to summon this stage's boss early. Defeat it to open the portal and skip the rest of the stage.
hoa.msg.shrine_summoning_stone_text.zhCN: 点击它可提前召唤本阶段的首领。击败首领即可开启传送门，跳过本阶段剩余部分。

hoa.msg.talents_reset_new_trees.enUS: Your talents were reset for the new trees. All points have been refunded.

hoa.msg.talk_to_enchanter.enUS: Talk to the enchanter at the end of a stage to enchant your gear.

hoa.msg.trinket_demonic_rune_text.zhCN: +25%力量。你每秒损失1%生命值，最低降至30%。

hoa.msg.trinket_gnomish_battle_goggles_t.enUS: Your spells deal up to 50% more damage the lower your health is.

hoa.msg.trinket_goblin_land_mine_text.enUS: Every 6 sec, drops a land mine at your feet. It explodes when an enemy touches it, dealing 60% of base health to enemies within 6 yards.

hoa.msg.trinket_goblin_pocket_gold_text.enUS: +1% Power for every 50 silver you pick up this run, up to 8%. You move 5% slower.
hoa.msg.trinket_goblin_pocket_gold_text.zhCN: 本次远征中每拾取50银币，+1%力量，最多8%。你的移动速度降低5%。

hoa.msg.trinket_goblin_rocket_boots_text.enUS: Your Dash goes 50% farther, but has a 5% chance to backfire and launch you in a random direction.
hoa.msg.trinket_goblin_rocket_boots_text.zhCN: 你的冲刺距离增加50%，但有5%几率失灵，把你朝随机方向发射出去。

hoa.msg.trinket_grinning_skull_of_wrath_.enUS: Your spells deal 30% more damage, but you take 30% more damage.
hoa.msg.trinket_grinning_skull_of_wrath_.zhCN: 你的法术造成的伤害提高30%，但你受到的伤害也提高30%。

hoa.msg.trinket_nifty_stopwatch_text.enUS: +1% dodge chance per sec while moving, up to 5%. Fades while standing still.
hoa.msg.trinket_nifty_stopwatch_text.zhCN: 移动时闪避几率每秒提高1%，最多5%。站立不动时会逐渐消退。

hoa.msg.trinket_rumsey_rum_text.enUS: +1% critical strike chance every 2 sec, up to 10%. Halved when you are hit.

hoa.msg.vendor_arrives.zhCN: 地精商人{1}在附近摆摊了！他会在1分钟后离开。

hoa.msg.vendor_chat_header.enUS: {1} shows you his wares, and you have {2} Valor. Type .bonk vendor buy <number> or .bonk vendor lock <number>, .bonk vendor reroll to restock for {3} Valor ({4} left), or .bonk vendor close.
hoa.msg.vendor_chat_header.zhCN: {1}向你展示了他的货物，你拥有{2}勇气点数。输入 .bonk vendor buy <number> 或 .bonk vendor lock <number>，输入 .bonk vendor reroll 可花费{3}勇气点数补货（剩余{4}次），或输入 .bonk vendor close 关闭。

hoa.msg.vendor_chat_price_gone.zhCN: {1}勇气点数，已不适合当前构筑

hoa.msg.vendor_doesnt_restock.enUS: {1} can't restock. Buy Restock from Nix Sparkwrench to unlock it.
hoa.msg.vendor_doesnt_restock.zhCN: {1}不会补货。向尼克斯·火花扳手购买“补货”升级即可解锁。

hoa.msg.vendor_no_more_wares.enUS: {1} has no more wares to restock this visit.

hoa.msg.vendor_text.enUS: {1} sells spells and upgrades for Valor. Click him before he moves on.
hoa.msg.vendor_text.zhCN: {1}以勇气点数出售法术和强化。在他离开前点击他。

hoa.msg.vendor_usage.zhCN: 用法：.bonk vendor buy|lock <number>，.bonk vendor reroll|close

hoa.msg.victory_you_cleared_take_portal.enUS: Victory! You cleared {1}. Take the portal home with your loot.
hoa.msg.victory_you_cleared_take_portal.zhCN: 胜利！你通关了{1}难度。带着战利品从传送门回家吧。

hoa.msg.victory_you_cleared_take_portal_.enUS: Victory! You cleared {1}. Use the portal to go home or carry on into the finale.
hoa.msg.victory_you_cleared_take_portal_.zhCN: 胜利！你通关了{1}。通过传送门回家，或继续进入终章。

hoa.msg.visit_darkmoon_deck_at_inn.enUS: Visit the Darkmoon Deck at the Inn to buy ban slots.
hoa.msg.visit_darkmoon_deck_at_inn.zhCN: 请到旅店的暗月套牌处购买禁用栏位。

hoa.msg.wait_for_hearth_ring.enUS: Wait for the ring to fill first.

hoa.msg.welcome_to_sandbox_talk_to.enUS: Welcome to the sandbox. Talk to the Sandbox Keeper behind you for dummies, enemies, levels and spells. Nothing here counts.
hoa.msg.welcome_to_sandbox_talk_to.zhCN: 欢迎来到沙盒。与你身后的沙盒管理员交谈，可以召唤木桩、敌人、提升等级和学习法术。这里的一切都不作数。

hoa.msg.you_already_hold_every_copy.enUS: You already hold every copy of {1}.
hoa.msg.you_already_hold_every_copy.zhCN: 你持有的{1}已达到最大张数。

hoa.msg.you_are_already_in_run.enUS: You are already in a run. Use .bonk stop to leave it.
hoa.msg.you_are_already_in_run.zhCN: 你已经在远征中了。使用 .bonk stop 离开远征。

hoa.msg.you_are_not_in_running.enUS: You are not in a running stage.
hoa.msg.you_are_not_in_running.zhCN: 你不在进行中的阶段里。

hoa.msg.you_are_not_in_sandbox.enUS: You are not in the sandbox. Use .bonk sandbox to enter it.
hoa.msg.you_are_not_in_sandbox.zhCN: 你不在沙盒中。使用 .bonk sandbox 进入沙盒。

hoa.msg.you_banished_for_rest_of.enUS: You banished {1} for the rest of this run.

hoa.msg.you_cant_change_your_title.enUS: You can't change your title during a run.
hoa.msg.you_cant_change_your_title.zhCN: 你不能在远征中更改头衔。

hoa.msg.you_caught_every_kobold_thief.zhCN: 你抓住了所有狗头人窃贼！

hoa.msg.you_caught_kobold_thief.zhCN: 你抓住了一个狗头人窃贼（{1}/{2}）！

hoa.msg.you_caught_treasure_goblin_it.enUS: You caught the treasure goblin! It dropped {1} Valor and a chest.
hoa.msg.you_caught_treasure_goblin_it.zhCN: 你抓住了财宝地精！它掉落了{1}勇气点数和一个宝箱。

hoa.msg.you_claimed_bounty_on_and.enUS: You claimed the bounty on {1} and earned a chest!
hoa.msg.you_claimed_bounty_on_and.zhCN: 你领取了{1}的赏金，获得一个宝箱！

hoa.msg.you_couldnt_travel_to_sandbox.enUS: You couldn't travel to the sandbox.

hoa.msg.you_defeated_and_chest_appears.zhCN: 你击败了{1}！一个宝箱出现了。

hoa.msg.you_destroyed_necrotic_shard_and.enUS: You destroyed a Necrotic Shard ({1}/{2}) and earned {3} Valor!
hoa.msg.you_destroyed_necrotic_shard_and.zhCN: 你摧毁了一块死疽碎片（{1}/{2}），获得{3}勇气点数！

hoa.msg.you_earned_talent_point_for.enUS: You earned a talent point for clearing {1}!
hoa.msg.you_earned_talent_point_for.zhCN: 你通关了{1}，获得了一个天赋点！

hoa.msg.you_extracted_its_waiting_in.enUS: You extracted {1}! It's waiting in your mailbox.
hoa.msg.you_extracted_its_waiting_in.zhCN: 你提取了{1}！它正在你的邮箱里等你。

hoa.msg.you_fell_so_sandbox_brought.enUS: You fell, so the sandbox brought you back.
hoa.msg.you_fell_so_sandbox_brought.zhCN: 你倒下了，沙盒把你带了回来。

hoa.msg.you_found_hearthstone_save_it.enUS: You found a Hearthstone! Use it to send one item from this run home. It only works during this run.
hoa.msg.you_found_hearthstone_save_it.zhCN: 你发现了一块炉石！用它可以立即将本次远征中找到的1件装备送回家。它只在本次远征中有效。

hoa.msg.you_got_back_up_revive_left.enUS: You got back up! {1} revive left.
hoa.msg.you_got_back_up_revive_left.zhCN: 你重新站了起来！还剩{1}次复活。

hoa.msg.you_got_back_up_revives_left.enUS: You got back up! {1} revives left.
hoa.msg.you_got_back_up_revives_left.zhCN: 你重新站了起来！还剩{1}次复活。

hoa.msg.you_must_complete_quests_to.enUS: You must complete {1} quests to buy rank {2} of {3}. You have completed {4}.
hoa.msg.you_must_complete_quests_to.zhCN: 你必须完成{1}个任务才能购买{3}第{2}级。你已完成{4}个。

hoa.msg.you_need_scrap_you_have.zhCN: 你需要{1}废料。你目前拥有{2}点。

hoa.msg.you_now_earn_more_gold.enUS: You now earn {1}% more gold and Darkmoon Tickets, but face {2}% more enemies.
hoa.msg.you_now_earn_more_gold.zhCN: 你现在获得的金币和暗月奖券提高{1}%，但敌人数量增加{2}%。

hoa.msg.you_put_in_your_bags.enUS: {1} was placed in your bags. Store it in the Extraction Vault to keep it.
hoa.msg.you_put_in_your_bags.zhCN: {1}已放入你的背包。想保留它就放进提取保险库。

hoa.msg.you_receive_scrap_from_this_run.enUS: You earned {1} Scrap this run. You now have {2}.
hoa.msg.you_receive_scrap_from_this_run.zhCN: 你从本次远征获得了{1}废料。你目前拥有{2}点。

hoa.msg.you_refunded_all_your_fortunes.enUS: You refunded all your fortunes and got {1} back.
hoa.msg.you_refunded_all_your_fortunes.zhCN: 你退还了所有运势，取回了{1}。

hoa.msg.you_refunded_all_your_upgrades.enUS: You refunded all your upgrades and got {1} back.
hoa.msg.you_refunded_all_your_upgrades.zhCN: 你退还了所有升级，取回了{1}。

hoa.msg.you_salvaged_for_valor.zhCN: 你拆解了{1}，获得{2}勇气点数。

hoa.msg.you_skipped_this_choice_and.enUS: You skipped this choice and got {1} Valor.
hoa.msg.you_skipped_this_choice_and.zhCN: 你跳过了这次选择，获得{1}勇气点数。

hoa.msg.you_turned_back_scourge_invasion.enUS: You turned back the Scourge invasion!

hoa.msg.you_were_brought_back_to.enUS: You were brought back to the Inn.

hoa.msg.you_werent_in_ring_when.enUS: You weren't in the ring when it filled, so the Hearthstone faded.
hoa.msg.you_werent_in_ring_when.zhCN: 法环填满时你不在其中，炉石消散了。

hoa.msg.your_arcanite_skeleton_key_opene.enUS: Your Arcanite Skeleton Key opened this chest for free!
hoa.msg.your_arcanite_skeleton_key_opene.zhCN: 你的奥金万能钥匙免费开启了此宝箱！

hoa.msg.your_glyph_of_echoes_gives.enUS: Your Glyph of Echoes gives {1} another rank.
hoa.msg.your_glyph_of_echoes_gives.zhCN: 你的回响雕文使{1}额外提升了一级。

hoa.msg.your_glyph_of_soul_harvest.enUS: Your Glyph of Soul Harvest awakens. You deal {1} damage for {2} seconds.
hoa.msg.your_glyph_of_soul_harvest.zhCN: 你的灵魂收割雕文觉醒了。{2}秒内，你造成{1}伤害。

hoa.msg.your_glyph_of_treasure_hunter.enUS: Your Glyph of the Treasure Hunter reveals a chest nearby.
hoa.msg.your_glyph_of_treasure_hunter.zhCN: 你的寻宝者雕文揭示了附近的一个宝箱。
